prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady walk along a snow-covered trail in the Mardi Himal Trail, Kaski, Nepal, under the dim light of night. The camera moves forward, capturing the crunching sound of snow beneath each step, as the path winds through a dense forest of bare trees shrouded in mist. The camera angle shifts slightly upward, revealing the dark, starless sky above, while the surrounding trees loom large, their branches heavy with snow. As the journey continues, the camera pans to the right, showcasing a steep, rocky slope blanketed in white, with patches of exposed earth peeking through. The scene transitions to a narrow, icy stream, its surface glistening under the faint moonlight, as the camera tilts downward, following the flow of water over smooth stones. The camera then focuses on a series of wooden logs laid across the stream, serving as a makeshift bridge, as the viewer carefully steps from log to log, maintaining balance amidst the slippery surface. The camera angle widens, capturing the expansive view of the snowy landscape stretching into the distance, with distant mountains barely visible through the haze. The final moments depict the camera moving uphill, navigating through a rugged terrain dotted with rocks and sparse vegetation, as the ambient light gradually dims, enveloping the scene in a serene, wintry stillness.
